title: Road to the Platinum - Leonida Legend
credits: List data: Exophase (PSN), XCT.live (Xbox) and TrueAchievements - two platform pipelines in agreement. Missable watch per PowerPyx; unconfirmed statuses per Output Lag.

steps.title: Touchdown in Leonida
steps.summary: The opening hours: the first mission, Chapter 1, an early errand - and the meditation watch starts here, because the spots tied to Chapter 1 may not wait for you.
steps.effort: The first few hours of the game
steps.ponr_note: POINT OF NO RETURN (watch): meditate at every Chapter 1 meditation spot before the chapter closes. Positive Mental Attitude's missable status is under investigation per PowerPyx - treat the early spots as now-or-never and this step can never hurt you.

steps.title: The story deepens
steps.summary: Chapters 2 and 3 with the middle-chapter missions: the heist, the family business and the headlines. The plot's money engine starts here.

steps.title: The endgame of the story
steps.summary: Chapter 4, the airport takedown, the last big operation and the final mission itself. Finish the campaign; free roam continues afterwards, so nothing else in this roadmap locks.

steps.title: Friends and strangers
steps.summary: The named strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's hunt. Finish strands rather than opening them all - eight completed strands bank the silver, and five of these carry trophies of their own.

steps.title: Leonida at play
steps.summary: The activity layer: stunts, ranges, races, drones, fishing, arcades and challenges. Start with Master of None - one try at each of the 9 activity types - and let the counters build from there.

steps.title: Partners in crime
steps.summary: The robbery and free-roam feat layer: partner escapes, shop chains, vaults, trucks, gang operations - and the money economy (laundering and spending) that funds the endgame purchases.
steps.effort: An evening or two of planned crime

steps.title: The sweep
steps.summary: Collectibles and coverage: card sets, WAiNK locations, vehicle discoveries and registrations, every area of the map, and all 8 garage properties once step 6 has made you rich.
steps.effort: A long, pleasant tour of the state

steps.title: The last mysteries, then the Legend
steps.summary: The honest tail: six unconfirmed trophies and three description-led ones, handled with readings and play-it-safe habits rather than invented steps - then the 100% gold and the platinum it unlocks.
steps.effort: The tail of a completion playthrough
